chunks: What al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Shuʿayb, from Abī Baṣīr, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about voluntary prayer during the night and the day, and he said:

That which is recommended such that one should not fall short of it is eight rakʿahs at the sun’s decline, and after the ẓuhr two rakʿahs, and before the ʿaṣr two rakʿahs, and after the maghrib two rakʿahs, and before the ʿatamah two rakʿahs, and from the time of saḥar eight rakʿahs, then he performs witr, and the witr is three separate rakʿahs, then two rakʿahs before salat al-fajr; and the most beloved night prayer to them is the end of the night.

So he clarified in this hadith that these forty-six rakʿahs are among what is recommended such that one should not fall short of them, and that what is besides them does not share with them in recommendation. As for the other hadiths besides these which imply a reduction from fifty rakʿahs, their common basis is all Zurārah, even if they are repeated through different chains, such as.

key_terms.التَّطَوُّعِ: voluntary prayer performed in addition to the obligatory salat
key_terms.السَّحَرِ: the pre-dawn time in which night prayer is performed
key_terms.الِاسْتِحْبَابِ: the state of being recommended in religious law
key_terms.الْوَتْرُ: the concluding odd-numbered portion of the night prayer
key_terms.زَوَالِ الشَّمْسِ: the time of the sun’s decline from its zenith, marking a prayer time
key_terms.صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ: the dawn prayer before which two recommended rakʿahs are performed
key_terms.مَفْصُولَةً: performed separately, with the rakʿahs distinct from one another

ai.seo_question: What are the recommended daily nawāfil prayers and when should they be performed according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith outlines the strongly recommended daily nawāfil prayers associated with the obligatory salat, specifying their number and times, especially the night prayer and witr. It also indicates that these forty-six rakʿahs hold a distinct degree of recommendation and highlights the preference for performing salat al-layl at the end of the night.
